name: Wordie🧩
desc:
🧩🎉Welcome to WORDIE where you have to guess a 5 letter word in 6 attempts.

Guess the hidden word in six tries, guided by color-coded clues: green for correct letters in the right spot, yellow for correct letters in the wrong spot, and grey for incorrect letters. Challenge yourself and see how many words you can solve! 🧠

😊Most Relaxing Game on Roblox

👍If you like the game please consider giving a thumbs up and a favorite, it helps me a lot!

Inspired by NYT Wordle
Tags: wordle,word,word game, guess word

scripts.title: OP AUTO WIN
scripts.script:
local lplr = game.Players.LocalPlayer
while true do
	task.wait()
	local args = {
	    [1] = true,
	    [2] = "Classic",
	    [3] = lplr.UserId.." : Key Gen #$%^&#&$($^#*EndGame"
	}
	
	game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Events.GameFinalOutcome:FireServer(unpack(args))
end

scripts.title: Free Wins Fixed
scripts.features: I didnt want to leak this remote event but since the creator added a "obfuscate" code for when it gens a word this is what you got for now and probably getting patched soon
scripts.script:
while wait(0.1) do
local args = {
    [1] = true,
    [2] = "Classic"
}

game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Events"):WaitForChild("GameFinalOutcome"):FireServer(unpack(args))
end

scripts.title: Free Wins
scripts.features: This script may work to get on leaderboard, yes it is slow
scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
while not player do
    Players.PlayerAdded:Wait()
    player = Players.LocalPlayer
end

local eventsFolder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Events")
local checkWordEvent = eventsFolder:WaitForChild("CheckWordEvent")

local currentWordObject = player:WaitForChild("Statistics"):WaitForChild("Game"):WaitForChild("CurrentWord")

local function fireCheckWordEvent()
    local currentWord = currentWordObject.Value
    local args = {
        [1] = currentWord
    }
    checkWordEvent:FireServer(unpack(args))
end

currentWordObject.Changed:Connect(fireCheckWordEvent)

fireCheckWordEvent()
